text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Mom and Dad, I decided to start off 
on a serious note this time. You see—"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
“Today is the first leg of the Triple 
Tiara, the Oka Sho, yes indeedy!”

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"I did an interview before the race, 
but... they asked such intense questions 
that I couldn't answer well, and my heart 
wouldn't stop pounding!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"But there was this girl who shone like a 
star. No matter what question she was 
asked, she stayed cool and unflappable... 
Um..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway! When it comes to the Triple 
Tiara, everyone looks super strong! I got 
myself all fired up and headed off to the 
race!"
